tiers: T1
Verified
read in the source and the value is the source's
T2
Confident unverified
from a source we trust but have not opened or cannot check
T3
Marginal unverified
from a source we doubt, or a bracket from sources that disagree
T4
Unverified
no source at all for the value, only a reason for its range
T5
Confident educated guess based on physics
a law of physics fixes the form and the size to within a factor of a few
T6
Marginal educated guess based on physics
physics fixes the form, but the size is argued, not derived
T7
Educated guess based on inferred physics
the physics is itself inferred from other bodies or other regimes
T8
Educated guess based on reputable fringe or new physics
a published but not yet accepted mechanism
T9
Educated guess based on needed output (full tweak)
chosen so that the generated sky matches what has to come out
tweaks: the value is used as its source gives it
moved within the error bar the source prints
moved until a published count or distribution is reproduced (a tuning target)
chosen by running the generator over many draws and looking at the outcome
Fitted to the outcome with no independent source
the number is whatever makes the output right
